title: A shared reputation
slide_intent: Show why a shared identifier can matter across distinct communities. People should be able to associate varied local events with a single movement.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can give each program’s images a recognizable context without making the local stories interchangeable.
demonstration: A grid of captioned photographs from different programs surrounds a diagram of overlapping paths. A red treatment ties much of the grid together and gives way to individual image colors.
practical_value: Choose local evidence for a program story while preserving the connection to the international identity.

content_islands.name: Premise and prompt
content_islands.spec: Place the statement of common reputation and the red local-story prompt in the left column.

content_islands.name: Movement diagram
content_islands.spec: Place the overlapping paths and labels for diverse communities and common identity in the first tile.

content_islands.name: Program mosaic
content_islands.spec: Build a close-set grid from captioned program photographs. Carry red across several tiles and leave part of the grid in full color.
